title: Chapter 1395 - 12: Twenty Thousand Years

Chapter 1395 - 12: Twenty Thousand Years

Chapter 1395: Chapter 12: Twenty Thousand Years

Milky Way dimension, the mighty river flows relentlessly.

Lin Yuan sits cross-legged, comprehending the flow of the Origin Dao in the Milky Way dimension.

Threads of special substance drift and weave before him.

It is the immortal substance of the third source world.

Of course, the immortal substance Lin Yuan condensed before him.

Does not directly come from the third source world but is reproduced through understanding its essence.

Recreated using his own power.

Lin Yuan’s eyes are filled with wonder, even after ten years of comprehension.

He remains utterly amazed by this special substance.

And even within the Milky Way dimension, the immortal substance can still stably exist.

One must know that many power systems or precious treasures can only last in their respective or similar dimensions.

Once removed, they collapse.

Without the environment for nurturing existence, most lifeforms or non-life forms are affected.

Even extremely powerful beings like time-lives, if trapped in a special dimensional space.

Would still be somewhat suppressed.

"It’s too perfect."

Lin Yuan’s mind is somewhat immersed.

The most microscopic particles of the immortal substance are composed of thirty-three basic units.

Thirty-three basic units weave in balance, individually not powerful.

But if gathered in numbers, it becomes a terrifying force reaching the thirteenth stage level.

The supreme emperor of the third source world, uses immortal substance to condense his true form, eventually exerting strength nearly equivalent to a Red Dust Immortal.

Lin Yuan takes it a step further, merely reshaping a tenth of his physique with immortal substance, and reaches the conventional Red Dust Immortal domain.

"However, after reshaping a tenth of the physical body with immortal substance, the time and immortal substance needed for reshaping the next tenth will increase significantly."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

He can spend ten years reshaping a tenth of his physical body, and for another ten years, may only reshape a twentieth or even a thirtieth of his physical body.

The enhancement of power is not as simple as one plus one equals two, and methods involving fundamental composition of body and soul are similar.

"Take it slowly."

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face, after reaching the thirteenth stage, time matters little to him.

Thirteenth-stage time-lives have reached a certain degree of eternity, seeing through many future timelines, as long as he doesn’t court death, he won’t die.

"Source worlds?"

Lin Yuan dispersed the immortal substance before him, feeling quite pleased.

The three source worlds he is currently exploring have greatly benefited him.

The ancestral bloodline and inheritance of the first source world.

The Rune Dao and lord status of the second source world.

The immortal substance of the third source world.

...

Great Wilderness Origin World.

A bronze Immortal Palace stands on the Nine Heavens.

Old and mysterious breath spreads, seeming to transcend time and space, independent in existence.

As Lin Yuan keeps taking action, wiping out one legacy after another, consciousnesses within the bronze Immortal Palace begin to awaken.

On the throne of the bronze Immortal Palace, a figure sits upright.

This figure opens their eyes at this moment, scenes appearing before them.

Below the throne, several figures also stand.

"Unexpectedly, in the current cultivation environment, such powerful individuals can still emerge?" the figure on the Immortal Palace throne muttered, looking down.

Since the long bygone days when Red Dust Immortals broke heaven’s shackles and stormed the immortal path, the cultivation environment of the Great Wilderness Origin World has slowly deteriorated.

The most notable is the gradual thinning of the immortal substance.

For Emperor Level powerhouses, immortal substance is everything.

Without immortal substance, Emperor Level power could only live a million years, despite their dazzling talents, how far could they advance in cultivation in such short time?

Living to the third life, fourth life.

Also requires ample immortal substance as a foundation.

Why can consuming immortal drugs allow an emperor to live a second life?

Because immortal drugs inherently contain immortal substance.

"What should be done now? Should we stop him from continuing the slaughter?"

A figure standing below the throne frowned and said.

Many races and forbidden zones in the Great Wilderness Origin World were left by Red Dust Immortals who broke into the immortal path.

The purpose of the bronze Immortal Palace’s existence is to maintain the stability of the Great Wilderness Origin World, preventing crises at the rear when Red Dust Immortals battle on the immortal path.

"Stop him?"

"Why stop him?"

The figure on the Immortal Palace throne shakes their head: "How great are the Red Dust Immortals? Spreading legacy, paving the way for all beings, but since they entered the immortal path, their descendants, their progeny, indulge in pleasures, initiating periodical dark turmoil to harvest living beings, tsk tsk....."

Silent are the figures below the throne.

Many ancient supremes and Forbidden Zone Masters in the Great Wilderness Origin World, besides dividing the physical bodies and Yuan of contemporary emperors, regularly harvest living beings to nourish and replenish their nearly exhausted minds.

Regarding this, the many beings in the Immortal Palace have long known, but for the sake of Red Dust Immortals, turned a blind eye.

"Rest assured, the bloodline legacy of Red Dust Immortals will not be severed, this is also causal order, the Red Dust Immortals said so before leaving."

The figure on the Immortal Palace throne said.

If not for the ancient supremes and Forbidden Zone Masters repeatedly harvesting, Emperor Tianyuan wouldn’t be settling accounts today.

"Indeed."

Below the throne, the figures slightly nodded.

Though Emperor Tianyuan’s means are fierce, he hasn’t done it too absolutely, like slaughtering a race, only cleansing the main line, as for branches and remnants? He hasn’t eradicated them entirely.
